# Oriol Morros Vilaseca

> Personal website of Oriol Morros, a software engineer in London building infrastructure for AI agents at Eli by Techbible. BSc Software Engineering from ARU Cambridge. Grew up in Manresa, near Barcelona, moved to England in 2023.

## Pages

- [Home](https://omorros.com): introduction, work summary, and life story
- [Projects](https://omorros.com/projects): personal projects like SnapShelf and BK-Shoot, plus hackathon builds and wins, including TrueVoice (overall winner, Voice AI Hack London 2026), OffBabel (Cosine and ExoLabs track winner, On-Device Agent Hackathon), Basket (track winner, Tokens LDN Multi-Agent Hackathon), and WILDSCAN (overall winner, Unicorn Mafia and Techbible hack night)
- [Work](https://omorros.com/work): AI agent infrastructure at Eli by Techbible, University of Cambridge, IBM MCP Context Forge, BSc at ARU Cambridge
- [Journal](https://omorros.com/journal): personal stories, like growing a TikTok to 1.5M followers and playing basketball in Bàsquet Manresa's academy and as a scholarship athlete
